body: Locked macro product shot on a dark brushed-aluminum desk. An open smoke-gray wireless-earbuds case and both earbuds remain completely still. Only the small emerald status LED on the front pulses from dim to bright, casts a tiny green halo, and fades back to dim on the final frame. Keep reflections fixed, no text.
